prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: one EXACT 3x3 contact sheet of NINE equal square panels, row-major progressive poses of ONE exercise's outward half-repetition. No borders, gaps, labels, arrows or text. Exactly same locked orthographic camera, scale, body proportions, skin shade, black shorts, black trainers, lighting, warm white background in every panel. Reference image is STYLE/athlete reference only: defined muscular adult man with warm natural skin, realistic high quality illustrated render; no toy, no polygon human. Full body and entire relevant apparatus fit each panel with matching coordinates. Preserve all femur, tibia, forearm, humerus lengths. Pose1=start, poses2-8 ordered monotonic intermediate positions, pose9=end. Never alternate start/end. EXERCISE high-to-low dual cable crossover, entire two cable towers shown with opaque side shrouds, fixed high pulleys, thin taut flexible steel cables attached to individual D-handles. Nearly frontal camera elevated slightly, see both arms clearly. Feet in short split stance fixed throughout, torso slight forward lean fixed, no sway. Start hands wide near shoulder height and just ahead of trunk (not behind it), elbows have CONSTANT gentle20deg bend. Each successive pose brings BOTH hands along symmetric down-and-forward arcs; last hands meet in front of lower sternum/upper abdomen WITHOUT crossing. NOT a press: do not bend/extend elbows to move handles. Cable runs from each high pulley to respective hand; changes angle and free length, never thick mechanical arms. Shoulder-to-elbow and elbow-to-hand bone lengths CONSTANT even as perspective changes. End hands NOT down at thighs. Both cables stay attached all poses; two hands only. Towers, feet, head height, skin/materials unchanged.
